title: Learner data requests
erased: This enrollment's learning data was erased. Only an audit skeleton remains.
intro: Export or erase this learner's personal data for this course when they ask. Each action is audited, and each export is shown to the learner with your name and role. Your export leaves out the learner's companion conversation and their own notes; the learner's own download includes them.
exported: Export prepared. Deliver it to the learner through a private channel.
erase.warning: Irreversible. Answers, conversations, learner model and personal teaching are redacted; the learner cannot continue this enrollment. Usage and extension accounting remain without content.
